name: Aurora Coil
tagline: The command center for your home's climate, engineered for the discerning few.
positioning: Aurora Coil unifies scheduling, diagnostics, and service history for homeowners who treat their HVAC as infrastructure worth mastering.

hero.h1: Your home's climate, finally under your command.
hero.sub: Aurora Coil turns a tangle of technicians, filters, and refrigerant into one calm, orchestrated system — the way great homes were always meant to run.

features.title: Living service ledger
features.description: Every coil cleaning, filter swap, and refrigerant top-off recorded in one immutable timeline you actually own — not buried in a technician's clipboard.

features.title: Predictive comfort
features.description: Sensor-informed forecasts flag a failing compressor weeks before it strands you in July heat. You schedule on your terms, not in a crisis.

features.title: Vetted technician orbit
features.description: Book only from a curated network of licensed specialists, each rated on your past jobs. No dispatch roulette, no mystery arrival windows.

features.title: Seasonal choreography
features.description: Aurora sequences spring tune-ups and winter prep automatically, so your system transitions between seasons without a single missed step.

features.title: True-cost clarity
features.description: Line-item estimates before anyone touches a unit, benchmarked against thousands of comparable homes. Surprises belong in movies, not invoices.

features.title: Whole-home mapping
features.description: A visual model of every duct run, register, and zone — so you and your tech speak the same language from the first minute.

testimonials.quote: I used to keep HVAC receipts in a shoebox and pray. Aurora Coil turned three furnaces across two properties into one legible system. I finally feel like the owner, not the hostage.
testimonials.name: Delia Marchetti

testimonials.quote: The predictive alert caught a bearing whine before my blower failed. A weekday repair instead of an emergency call saved me roughly four hundred dollars and one very hot night.
testimonials.name: Ronan Ives

testimonials.quote: As a semi-retired mechanical engineer, I'm picky. Aurora's duct map and cost benchmarks are the first tools that respect how much I actually want to know.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the single-home owner who wants order and foresight.

pricing.period: per month, up to three homes
pricing.blurb: For those managing a primary home plus a getaway or two.
For collectors of properties who demand total oversight.

homepage.footerBlurb: Aurora Coil is the climate command platform for people who refuse to leave their home's comfort to chance. Master the system that keeps you human.
